parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_hierarchy to define the compound set from parent CHEMBL1336 including parent and all salts. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno, then docs on doc_id to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Join activities on record_id, then assays on assay_id to retrieve assay_description. Join target_dictionary on tid to retrieve target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by target CHEMBL279 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not limit rows.
